subject.title: [Bug]: Documented channels.telegram.chunkMode / blockStreamingCoalesce rejected by plugin validator → gateway crash loop on restart — 2026.6.11

question: Should Telegram flat delivery keys `channels.telegram.chunkMode` and `channels.telegram.blockStreamingCoalesce` remain accepted public config, or should docs and doctor force the nested `channels.telegram.streaming.*` shape only?
rationale: The latest release docs advertise the flat keys, while the doctor message and repository config policy call them legacy; the linked fix PR needs this contract choice before the issue can be closed with confidence.

options.title: Accept documented flat keys
options.body: Treat the shipped docs and runtime resolver behavior as the user contract, then land a tested schema fix and clarify canonical nested docs separately if desired.

options.title: Canonicalize nested streaming only
options.body: Reject flat keys, update Telegram and streaming docs, and improve doctor/recovery guidance so users are not led into an invalid startup config.

recommendation.title: Accept documented flat keys
recommendation.body: Treat the shipped docs and runtime resolver behavior as the user contract, then land a tested schema fix and clarify canonical nested docs separately if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame on the schema/docs/doctor lines and broad repository routing make this the clearest available owner for the config-contract decision.
